note: A WEAK HIT, narrated as success at a price.

toolResults.contextForStory: [Action roll - cross the plank: score 8 against 7 and 9 -> WEAK HIT]

playerLine: I carry the cask across the plank.
narration: You get the cask across, but the plank bucks halfway and a stave cracks against the rail. By the time your boots hit the deck the cask is leaking a dark thread of wine down your sleeve, and you will not get it all home.

characterContext.playerSummary: A ferry-hand with a borrowed name.
